implementationDefinitions.CanonicalProvider: An exact canonical provider version runs through the bounded ZigCSS host and feeds strict generated CSS into the native compiler.
implementationDefinitions.LegacyCharacterized: Heuristic adapter source remains only behind the test-only legacy boundary.
implementationDefinitions.LimitedNative: A closed ZigCSS-native subset uses the rebuilt parser and public result ownership boundary.
implementationDefinitions.Removed: No adapter parser source or legacy Format tag remains; filename handling exists only to reject the unavailable input.

availabilityDefinitions.CanonicalCliApi: Available through the npm CLI and API with extension detection or an explicit syntax value.
availabilityDefinitions.Unavailable: Rejected by the recovery CLI before output and absent from the public compile syntax enum.
availabilityDefinitions.ExperimentalLibrary: Available only through an explicit Zig library syntax tag; the recovery CLI and LSP still reject the extension.

compatibilityDefinitions.CanonicalVersion: Language behavior is owned by the exact published canonical provider version; ecosystem extension parity is separate.
compatibilityDefinitions.Unverified: Legacy characterization is not a compatibility contract or supported subset.
compatibilityDefinitions.NativeSubset: Only the exact published ZigCSS-native grammar and result contract are supported; this is not full ecosystem compatibility.

strategyDefinitions.canonical-integration: Integrate an exact canonical provider version through the bounded zigcss-preprocessor-v1 host and graduate only after its complete admission gate passes.
strategyDefinitions.limited-native-subset: Implement only a closed named grammar with strict errors outside it.
strategyDefinitions.remove-until-funded: Expose no adapter or ecosystem claim unless a later funded program accepts a new decision.

adapters.currentBoundary: The npm CLI/API route SCSS through exact Dart Sass 1.101.0, confined imports, strict generated-CSS validation, deterministic output, and owned diagnostics, dependencies, and maps.
knownRisks: Canonical language behavior does not enable arbitrary Sass plugins, custom functions, custom importers, or future Dart Sass versions; executable project code requires a separate trusted mode.

containmentEvidence.contains: Network access is disabled in the ZigCSS canonical preprocessor host

adapters.currentBoundary: The npm CLI/API route indented Sass through exact Dart Sass 1.101.0 without source rewriting, with confined imports and strict ZigCSS validation of generated CSS.
knownRisks: Canonical language behavior does not enable arbitrary Sass plugins, custom functions, custom importers, or future Dart Sass versions; executable project code requires a separate trusted mode.

containmentEvidence.contains: Network access is disabled in the ZigCSS canonical preprocessor host

adapters.currentBoundary: The npm CLI/API route Less through exact Less 4.6.7 with confined imports/assets, executable JavaScript and plugins disabled, and strict ZigCSS validation of generated CSS.
knownRisks: Canonical language behavior does not enable Less plugins, JavaScript evaluation, custom file managers, or future Less versions; executable project code requires a separate trusted mode.

adapters.currentBoundary: The npm CLI/API route Stylus through exact Stylus 0.64.0 with resolver-owned imports/assets, project plugins denied, and strict ZigCSS validation of generated CSS.
knownRisks: Canonical language behavior does not enable Stylus use() plugins, custom functions, custom evaluators, or future Stylus versions; executable project code requires a separate trusted mode.

adapters.currentBoundary: The Zig library scopes local-by-default classes, supports functional scope, plain-class composition, and token-aware local @value definitions, and returns owned class/value exports plus bounded module dependency facts. CLI and LSP exposure remain disabled.
knownRisks: Bare or structurally ambiguous scope switches, imported @value resolution, and raw module imports/exports remain strict errors under the chosen MODULE-002 scope.
Composition deliberately accepts only one plain local class target and returns unresolved external references rather than loading or flattening another module.
Local values replace identifier tokens in declaration values, supported at-rule preludes, and class aliases only; other selector positions are strict errors.
Untyped functional pseudos, selector-bearing or unknown at-rules, optimizer/prefix transforms, and native plugins remain outside the subset.

adapters.currentBoundary: No CSS-in-JS parser implementation remains; .css.js and .css.ts are classified only for explicit CLI rejection and a null legacy detector result.
knownRisks: Reintroducing byte scanning without a version-pinned JavaScript/TypeScript parser, explicit tagged-template scope, non-executing static semantics, and strict dynamic-expression behavior would recreate the removed deletion boundary.

adapters.currentBoundary: No PostCSS-like parser implementation remains; .postcss is classified only for explicit CLI rejection and a null legacy detector result.
knownRisks: Reintroducing fixed directive scanning without a real isolated JavaScript plugin host, versioned lifecycle, configuration, ordering, dependency, diagnostic, and source-map contracts would recreate the removed deletion boundary.

adapters.currentBoundary: No Tailwind-like fixed utility registry or @apply scanner remains; .postcss is retained only as an explicit CLI rejection and null legacy detector result.
knownRisks: Reintroducing a fixed table under the Tailwind name without canonical content scanning, configuration, versions, variants, plugins, arbitrary values, ordering, and strict unknown-utility behavior would recreate the removed compatibility claim.
